title: InvisibleGlass
description: A client-side mode with customizeable glass opacity and other settings, MamtakLib is needed
body:
# InvisibleGlass

**InvisibleGlass** is a lightweight **client-side Fabric mod** that lets you customize how glass looks in Minecraft.

### Features

- **Control glass opacity**
- **Adjust visual settings**
- **Client-side only**
- **Works on servers**
- **Simple and lightweight**

### Why use it?

InvisibleGlass is great if you want cleaner builds, better visibility, or a more minimal glass look without changing gameplay.

### Problem
Setting glass to a specific opacity currently only works in version 1.21.11 due to rendering limitations in other versions. 

### Info
- Mod Loader: Fabric
- Side: Client

**Library needed : [Mamtak-Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/mamtak-lib)**
